brief:
GAZA CITY — A veterinarian in Gaza is treating sick and injured animals despite severe shortages of medical supplies caused by ongoing conflict, Palestine News Network reported. Mutasim Qadura has continued his work as war has displaced residents and created widespread humanitarian need across the territory. His clinic has become a refuge for animals suffering from wounds and illness.

The report, by Nesma Al-Harazin, documents how Qadura addresses animal suffering alongside the human toll of the conflict. As conventional medicines have become scarce, he has adapted his practice to continue providing care to creatures caught in the crossfire of the war in Gaza.

title: Gaza veterinarian treats animals as medicine supplies dwindle
